result_text:
Dotfiles and dotted folders are no longer ignored. Only version-control contents are dropped, IDE and build-tool folders now go to build-and-deployment, and `dependencies` folders are no longer ignored. The change is in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`, and I didn't commit.

- **Ignore list:** the `Hidden files and folders` rule is replaced by `(.*/)?[.](git|svn|hg|bzr)/.*` ("Version control metadata"). The `(.*/)?` prefix makes it match at any depth and for a path that starts directly with `.git/`, since paths are matched as whole strings.
- **Build-and-deployment list:** added `(.*/)?[.](idea|vscode|vs|gradle|mvn|settings|metadata|circleci)/.*` ("IDE and build tool configuration") next to the existing `.git[a-z]+` rule.
- **Dependencies:** removed the `.*/dependencies/.*` ignore rule.

The `.yarn`, `node_modules`, `vendor` and other rules are untouched.

`mvn -q -o -pl codeanalyzer test` on `SourceFileFilterTest`, `SourceCodeFilesTest` and `CodeConfigurationTest` passed (18 tests, 0 failures). Those tests don't exercise the new regexes, and my scratch check of the regexes was blocked by the sandbox, so the regex behaviour is verified by reading only. I didn't add a dedicated test for the new rules.
